DV Trading LLC is a proprietary financial services firm, and DV Commodities provides liquidity and risk allocation across global commodities markets. The 2027 Graduate Software Engineer will build and improve proprietary trading tools, collaborate with developers, traders, researchers, and stakeholders, and architect and support trading applications using AI-assisted development.
Payments
Trading Platform
Comp. & Benefits
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Build and improve a variety of proprietary trading tools to support the trading desks across the business
Collaborate with other developers, tech leaders, traders, and researchers to outline the technical needs for each trading application
Work with technology and business stakeholders in iterative fashion to deliver platform functionality
Architect greenfield solutions to address business needs, and work with equal confidence in established codebases: quickly building context in unfamiliar systems, extending them safely, and improving them as you go
Use AI to accelerate development while taking full ownership of your code: apply engineering judgment across the entire lifecycle, from design and edge case handling through deployment and production support

C++

AI-Assisted Software Development
Quantitative Programming
Latency-Sensitive Programming
Required
Expected to graduate with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field by **Summer 2027**
Experience programming in either C++ and/or Python in Linux environments, ideally on quantitative or latency-sensitive problems
Accelerate development with AI tools while fully owning your code from verification through edge case handling
Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills
Benefits
This role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus (at DV Trading's discretion) and DV Trading's benefits package.
